speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
title: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan spoke about “The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants”.

quotes.text: The lesson I learned is this: No time or effort is ever wasted in reading the Book of Mormon. Not for you, not for your children, not for your family, not for anyone.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You see, while my ancestors were united with the Saints in Nauvoo, they had made covenants in the temple. Rebecca then read some of the beautiful and comforting prophetic teachings on this topic, which provide that because of “the eternal sealings of faithful parents and the divine promises made to them[,] … though some of the sheep may wander, the eye of the Shepherd is upon them, and sooner or later they will feel the tentacles of Divine Providence reaching out after them and drawing them back to the fold.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It is exactly how the Lord revealed it to the Prophet Joseph Smith: “And he shall plant in the hearts of the children the promises made to the fathers, and the hearts of the children shall turn to their fathers.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: We can see this promise being fulfilled in our day. In the Book of Mormon, the Lord made a covenant with Enos that the remnant of the people living at that time would someday receive his words and the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ. Was there a time limit to that covenant? That covenant would take more than 2,000 years to be fulfilled. So, no, there is no limit to the power of God in our covenants.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Covenants with God are filled with incalculable power. They do not bless just the maker of the covenant but are generational in their impact. We are all the intended beneficiaries of countless covenants! Like the great binding power of gravity that stretches across the universe, covenants with God stretch over all time and all space.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: If you are wondering whether you or a loved one has wandered so far away that the love of God and His covenantal power cannot reach you—I say to you, you have not. As President Jeffrey R. Holland so beautifully said: “You have not traveled beyond the reach of divine love. It is not possible for you to sink lower than the infinite light of Christ’s Atonement shines.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Atonement of Jesus Christ is the fulfillment of the greatest promise God made—that Jesus Christ would be our Savior and Redeemer. The power and reach of that covenant is infinite and eternal.
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Some may be crying out right now, with words like “O, God, where art Thou? My child is struggling.” Take comfort; God hears you and will answer your prayers in His own time and in His own way. Keep your covenants, strive to be faithful, and “cheerfully do all things that lie in [your] power; and then may [you] stand still, with the utmost assurance, to see the salvation of God, and for his arm to be revealed.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Jeremiah J. Morgan
quotes.talk: The Infinite Power of God in Our Covenants
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
